testcase.name: plain bullets are read as tasks when the document has no checkboxes
a due date is lifted out of the line, marker and all
plain bullets are ignored once the document uses checkboxes
a document with nothing in it is an empty list rather than a failure
a markdown checklist keeps what is open and drops what is done
headings name the list and say where each task came from
an empty box with nothing after it is not a task
markdown punctuation is not printed at the viewer
a json document is read, and its finished items are dropped
broken json and an unknown schema are refused
a task with no date has no date
a bare json array is a list too
a link keeps its text and loses its address
a list with everything ticked is finished, not a list of bullets
a json document with no items is an empty list rather than a failure
